title: Bournemouth allowed to dream, but 'taking nothing for granted' – Rose
subtitle: FotMob
paragraphs: NewsAboutBournemouth allowed to dream, but 'taking nothing for granted' – RoseShareBournemouth will take their 10-game winning streak in all competitions to Craven Cottage, with Fulham the latest to go up against them.Marco Rose insists Bournemouth are "taking nothing for granted" amid their 10-game winning streak in all competitions ahead of facing Fulham.
Rose had a tough start to life on the south coast, with Bournemouth failing to win any of their first six Premier League games (D3 L3).

However, they are now up to fifth in the top-flight after a five-game winning run and sit top of the Europa League table with a 100% record (W5), coming from behind to beat Celta Vigo 2-1 despite Bafode Diakite's first-half red card.
Bournemouth are the in-form side in the Premier League ahead of MD12, but Marco Rose says his side are not thinking too far ahead, with all focus on Fulham.
"Always allowed to dream but, for us, it's always about the next game," Rose said.
"After a tough start, we are now in a good situation, a good spot, and we feel good. But we take nothing for granted, and everything is hard work.
"That is what we have to know. If we step back or drop in just one topic, then it is getting difficult in every competition we play."
Fulham also struggled to get going under Alvaro Arbeloa, but they are now on a five-game unbeaten streak in the Premier League (W2 D3), though they have drawn their last three, all 1-1, to sit 15th.
Calvin Bassey has drawn interest from Manchester United, with the Red Devils reportedly interested in a January move for the Fulham defender, but Arbeloa was quick to shut down any rumours.
"I am so happy with Calvin Bassey. There is no chance he can leave this club in January," Arbeloa said.
"I think he is happy here; he is one of our captains and leaders, and you can see how well he is playing.
"It is normal to see that so many clubs are interested in him; that is good for him, good for us because that means he is performing really well.
"That is important for me as a coach and the club. We are working on a new contract, and I hope he can sign as soon as possible."
Rodrigo Muniz is looking to score in three consecutive Premier League appearances for the first time since April 2025.
His two previous goals against Bournemouth both came in the same game, a brace in a 3-1 home win in February 2024.

Evanilson has been involved in more goals than any other player in the Premier League this season (six goals, four assists), scoring in six consecutive appearances, the best-ever run by both a Bournemouth player and a Brazilian.
Sergio Aguero is the only South American to score in seven straight matches from May to September 2019.
Bournemouth have won six of their 10 Premier League games against Fulham (D2 L2), including each of the last three in a row. It is their highest win rate against any side they have faced 10+ times.
Fulham have won just one of their last 11 home league games against Bournemouth (D5 L5), a 3-1 victory in February 2024.
Bournemouth have won five Premier League games in a row, their longest-ever run. They last had a longer winning league run in March/April 2021 in the Championship (seven in a row).
